explication: YugabyteDB is a PostgreSQL-compatible distributed SQL database with YSQL and YCQL APIs. The principal workflow is an application submitting a query through an API layer, which executes against distributed storage and returns results; replicated writes and transactions provide consistency and availability. The README documents capabilities beyond the sampled implementation excerpts, so those branches are represented at the source paths available in the tree. Edges use README statements or sampled source evidence; unsampled internals are not inferred as detailed call chains.
